events.title: First Thursday at LoveJoy
events.description: A first look at LoveJoy Market in its own home, with $1 concessions and a small print bar planned.

events.title: Adult Makers Market
events.description: Free entry, six hands-on makers, a print bar, open art, coffee, and quick $50 event flash in the background.

events.title: Kids Makers Market
events.description: $7 per child, $24 for four, then $5 each additional child. One $5 Maker Token and open art are included.

events.title: LoveJoy Weird Movie Night
events.description: $5 per person with strict limited seating. Upstairs is movie-only; downstairs adds $1 concessions and themed quick flash.

events.title: Family Halloween Movie Night
events.description: $5 for every child and adult. Best for about age 9+. Guardians stay onsite and seating is limited.

events.title: Halloween Flash Day
events.description: $40 total quick flash, a numbered waitlist, $1 concessions, and no mystery math.
